segmente.text: Nobody wakes up and thinks, I want someone to sell me something today.
But people buy things every single day.
When it feels like your idea, you want to have it.
But when it feels like their idea, you resist it.
This is why the best marketers don't push aggressively.
Instead, they create the conditions where buying feels like the obvious, logical, and personal decision.
Make them feel like they found it.
